summary: Disc Medicine filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 reporting initial results from the Phase 2 RESTORE-PV trial of DISC-3405 in polycythemia vera. The open-label trial enrolled 40 adults; Cohort A received 300 mg subcutaneously every two weeks and Cohort B every four weeks. In 13 patients completing 26 weeks, mean phlebotomy events fell from 4.0 to 0.6 (p<0.0001), 61.5% remained phlebotomy-free, and hematocrit was controlled below 45%. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed; this is a routine clinical data update under Items 7.01 and 8.01.
